title: Once-only create guard matches error text only; match the error type and prove it on a real backend
description:
**Problem.** The once-only create in the wake-keys handler (`amplify/functions/procedure-action/handler.ts:253-275`, `wake-key.ts`) treats a create error as a duplicate only if the error text matches `conditional request failed` or `ConditionalCheckFailed`. If the text ever differs, a duplicate wake shows as a failed start (it cannot run twice, but it fails falsely). Nothing has proven the guard against a real backend: the Gherkin uses a fake backend and the unit test feeds the pattern a string.

**Fix.** Match the error type (`DynamoDB:ConditionalCheckFailedException`) as well as the text. Then prove it once on Machines on Machines, before the wake queue relies on redelivery.

**Acceptance criteria**
- The handler treats an error as a duplicate when its type is the conditional-check type, or its text matches; any other error is still thrown.
- On Machines on Machines after its 5.130 bump, the same wake key started twice (signed-in CLI) leaves one run record and the second answer says `duplicate: true`. The result is recorded on this task and on PPY-567bf9.
- If `papyrus procedures run` cannot take a wake key, add that to the CLI (and its spec) so the check can be done without hand-made calls.
- PPY-567bf9 (B1) lists this proof among its acceptance lines and its release is blocked by this task.

**Gherkin features needed**
- wake-key-duplicate.feature: 'a create refused with the conditional-check error type answers duplicate'; 'a create refused with the old text answers duplicate'; 'any other create error is thrown'. Entry point: the handler, not the regex helper.

**Dependencies:** blocks PPY-567bf9 (B1). Follows PPY-70c6e8 (closed); does not reopen it. Needs Machines on Machines on 5.130 for the real-backend check (see the Release 5.130 plan task).

**Report:** papyrus-track-report-1.md, section 3a hazard 1; checklist step 11.
